以前看到Winry这类「真交易员」，
其实挺羡慕。

完全不需要广子，
光靠交易就能在这个圈子活下去。
对一年前资产不到150W人民币的我来说，
这种人多少有点像「真神」。

那时候总觉得：
要和机构大哥、美女姐姐搞好关系， 要学着去舔 BD。

「那时候的内心OS：
没有广子，我都不敢想自己该怎么活。」
———————————————
进入2026年后，
合作越来越少，
我的画风也越来越直，
很多时候说话毫无顾虑。
虽然我本人不直😂哈哈哈，
多半也因为这个状态，
合作又更少了。

但我也没想到，
相较于一年前，
在没什么合作的情况下， 
资产反而多了近 200W人民币。
———————————————
大半年前，
账面上也有过 300W-400W人民币的锁仓资产。

群友总在群里说：
“等你解锁能卖的时候， 10W人民币还有没有？”
后来，一语成谶😂

现在回头看，
纸面上无法交易的 300W人民币，
和真正能自由支配的 300W人民币， 
完全是两个状态。
———————————————
过去了一年，
我依然不算什么「真交易员」。

但至少，
已经不用再想：
没有广子，我该怎么活了。

当然，
我还是很希望能有机会拥抱一个赛道！
和看好的项目一起成长！！！
———————————————
一年后的我，
又会是什么样？🤔

author: 0xSearchie

One of my favourite lowkey strategies on HyperLend is using LSTs to effectively lower your borrow costs by quite a substantive amount.

Let's say you're holding $1 Mill in HYPE. If you chose to deposit it as kHYPE into HyperLend you keep your staking rate, which averages around 2% APR, around $20k a year.

Then, you decide you need some liquidity, so you decide to take out a $500,000 USDC loan. USDC currently costs ~7.5% APR to borrow, annualising out to ~$35k a year in interest.

By transitioning into an LST and using the staking interest accrued to offset your borrow cost you now have a loan of $500,000 at the effective borrow cost of $17,500 a year, or 3.5% APR.

text:
如果你在用 GPT-6 Astra 跑 Coding Agent，我很推荐 Eric 这篇文章。

他在 Codex DX 做开发者体验，这篇最有启发的地方是，模型变强以后，很多以前「为了防模型犯错」加上的 Harness，已经开始变成负担。

比如 Skill 不要装一堆。每个 Skill 的名字和描述都会进 Context，太多以后 Codex 甚至会压缩描述，最后模型反而更难判断该选哪个。更好的做法是让 Skill 像一个轻量 Router，先告诉模型什么时候该用，再按需去读后面的文档和脚本。

AGENTS.md 也是一样。以前会写「每次改代码前先读完整 Repo Map、先跑一遍测试」，现在 Astra 很多时候自己就知道该读什么、该验证什么，这些固定流程反而会白白烧 Context 和时间。

还有一个我很认同的点是，把「边界」和「完成条件」写清楚。Astra 对限制更认真，有时候反而会太早停，所以与其继续加一堆步骤，不如直接告诉它哪些事情可以自己继续做，以及做到什么程度才算真正完成。

所以 Coding Agent 的配置真的要跟着模型一起升级。

以前我们在不断给模型加说明，现在需要学会删说明。Harness 的价值像是给模型留下必要的约束和 Context，而不是把每一步都规定死。

text:
Midas Markets 就是 Perps 赛道的 FOMO
二者看似殊途，实则同归

1/ 你打开交易所的时候，脑子里在想什么？
打开币安、OKX，迎面而来的就是搜索框、交易对列表、K 线图、买卖面板。整个界面都在默认一件事，即用户已经知道自己要干什么，只是需要一个地方把它完成。
换句话说，传统交易所只负责从“你决定买”那一刻起往后的事。至于你是怎么决定的，在 Twitter 上看到了什么、在群里听到了什么、自己研究了什么，平台不管，也管不了。

但 @fomo 和 @midasmarketsxyz, 都想把这一步也装进来。

2/ FOMO 是怎么做的？
打开 FOMO，你看到的不是交易面板，而是一条条内容。
你可能根本没想好要买什么，甚至没打算交易，只是随便刷刷、看看大家最近在玩什么。但刷着刷着，你看到某个 KOL 晒了一笔 10 倍收益，评论区一片 FOMO 情绪，或者一大堆聪明钱正在涌入。
一个模糊的好奇心，就这样变成了一笔具体的交易。

FOMO 的逻辑是，通过内容发现机会，通过社交氛围激发欲望。
交易是浏览过程中的自然产物。

3/ Midas 怎么做的？
Midas 的方式不同，但结构一样。
用户打开 Midas，第一眼看到的不是合约交易界面，而是新闻与观点栏。没有人是带着“我要做多黄金”的念头打开 Midas 的，他是读完一条美联储消息、看完 AI 对影响的分析、收到一份包含入场点和止损位的建议之后，才产生了交易意图。

FOMO 用社交情绪驱动你，Midas 用分析说服你。
手段不同，但做的是同一件事，在产品内部完成从信息到交易意图的转化。

4/ 这件事为什么重要？
这个反转并不新鲜，内容产业早就走过这条路。

▌Google 时代的假设是用户带着问题来，输入关键词，产品负责给答案。这对应传统交易所的搜索框。
▌抖音 / TikTok 时代的假设是用户没有问题、只是无聊，打开后产品负责让你产生兴趣。这对应 FOMO 和 Midas 的内容流。

每一次这种迁移的结果都一样，控制入口的一方，拿走了整条价值链的定价权。
链上交易，正处在这个迁移的早期阶段。

5/ Midas 不会像 FOMO 那样爆发式增长
虽然 FOMO 和 Midas 在“信息→交易”的结构上同构，但它们长大的方式完全不一样。

▌FOMO 的增长靠网络效应
FOMO 的信息由用户自己生产。谁买了、赚了多少、为什么买，这些本身就是内容。每个用户既是消费者也是传播者。你买了一个 Meme 币发了条帖子，你的关注者看到后跟着买了又发了一条，新一轮扩散就开始了。
用户越多 → 内容越多 → 吸引更多用户。

▌Midas 的增长靠工具效率
Midas 的信息来自新闻和 AI，用户是单向消费者。一个用户的存在，不会让产品对下一个用户更有吸引力。它的增长依赖外部获客和口碑积累，而不是产品内部的自发裂变。

一句话，FOMO 的用户就是它的渠道，Midas 的用户只是它的客户。

所以我判断，Midas 不会像 FOMO 那样爆发式增长，但会更加细水长流。
爆发力属于社交，持久力属于工具。两种增长，两种命运。

不妨试试 Midas  - https://t.co/ZhihdpY4Zr

text:
从费马大定理验证到vibe science：ai的新能力如何重塑科研

Anthropic 昨天宣布使用 Claude 智能体在 11 天内完成了费马大定理（Fermat’s Last Theorem）的端到端计算机形式化验证，全部代码均在 Lean 证明助手 中通过编译。

这项突破的实质在于攻破了超长链条、高难度现代数理工程的自动化形式化壁垒，标志着科学研究正加速从传统的“假说与叙事科学”迈向“可计算、可自动验证的确定性科学”。

将人类自然语言写就的复杂数学成果转化为严谨的机器证明语言，曾被视作需要顶尖学者耗时数年的手工作坊式工程。
而Claude 在 11 天内生成了约 1300 万行 Lean 代码，完成了包含 29,500 个中间定理 的复杂推导。所有逻辑仅基于 Lean 的三条标准数学公理，并已在 GitHub 完全开源。

针对多智能体协作初期出现的上下文丢失与废弃代码问题，团队接入了哥伦比亚大学等开发的 Prove2Me 架构。通过动态维护定理依赖拓扑图（DAG）、解耦定理声明与推导细节、建立自然语言语义索引，数十个 AI 智能体得以在大规模并行中避免任务漂移。

随后进行的小型实验表明，仅需 3 个个人订阅账号，智能体便在 3 天内完成了维诺格拉多夫三素数定理的形式化。高难度形式化验证正从极少数头部算力实验室外溢为普通学者触手可及的基础工具。

这将为基础科学研究带来巨大的推动!

大语言模型在前沿科学探索中长期面临致命瓶颈：缺乏客观环境反馈，极易产生逻辑自洽却根本错误的“幻觉”。自动形式化的成熟为此补齐了最关键的逻辑闭环。

构建理论科学的“零容错评判器”：形式化证明系统充当了数理逻辑的物理引擎。大模型得以在严格公理体系下进行无幻觉的“自我博弈”（Self-play）与强化学习，自主推演新定理、检索反例并试错进化。

打破学科割裂，重组知识拓扑：分散在数以千万计论文中的非结构化知识，正被重构为全球可检索、跨学科互通的定理拓扑网络。计算机能够敏锐识别代数拓扑、量子场论与信息论之间的底层同构，加速催生跨界突破。

这种机器约束下的确定性搜索能力，正在重塑前沿科学理论与工业研发的核心链条，并加速从科研到应用的落地速度。

基础物理与数学的自洽性推演：量子场论、超弦理论与高维引力涉及庞大的张量运算与反常抵消。自动形式化工具能将物理假设转化为公理，快速排查复杂统一理论的隐蔽逻辑漏洞。

芯片 EDA 的全栈形式化等价验证：传统半导体验证占据 60% 以上研发周期且仍无法穷尽隐蔽死锁。大规模自动形式化使 2 纳米及以下微架构、乱序执行核与缓存一致性协议在流片前实现“数学级全状态等价证明”。

生物医药的物理动力学严密约束：在蛋白质设计与药物分子生成中，将热力学定律与反应动力学方程转化为形式化前置规范，能在生成初期用机器证明直接剔除违背物理实际的候选分子。

当自动形式化将繁琐的引理推导、边界检验与繁重验证完全托付给机器，科研人员的角色正迎来本质重构，science正在向coding一样，迎来vibe sicience时刻！

quoted_text:
分享一个无用的知识：

Robinhood 可能只要改一个参数就能实现链上gas 费的量级降低。

叫gas target，这个参数并非指块的硬容量上限，gas limit 才是。它是由官方设置的用来调整base fee 的理想用量，实际负载超过理想用量，就会出现积压（gas backlog），积压越多，base fee 就越高，对应的L2 执行费就越贵。

昨天RH Chain 的平均实际负载大概是4000万 gas/s，官方虽并未公布gas target 这项指标，但可以确定gas target 会在一定程度上低于4000万 gas/s，导致积压严重，从而产生了天价的gas fee。

Robinhood 同样未公布gas limit 的具体数值，如果按它的技术栈Arbitrum Orbit 默认的3200万 gas/ 块：RH Chain 的出块速度是0.1s/ 块，那么它理论上的gas limit 应该为3.2亿 gas/s。

TLDR:
只要把gas target 的参数调整到高于链上的实际负载，gas 费就能实现量级降低。

quoted_text:
Everyone should be able to access high-quality financial assets, wherever they live.

That's what tokenization unlocks: taking the best of US capital markets and making them available on a global scale.

The industry is still small compared with global finance, but the advantages are becoming harder to ignore. Traditional market infrastructure was built around fixed hours, closed networks and layers of intermediaries. It was never designed for 24/7 execution, programmable assets, composability or self-custody.

The needs of investors have moved faster than the rails underneath them. We're working to change that.

What gives me confidence is seeing how many different people are now pushing this industry forward. Founders are building new products, LPs are bringing liquidity, traders are finding new uses, and infrastructure teams are making the whole thing work.

It's a privilege to be in the trenches with all of you.

We are still early, and there is a huge amount left to build. It will also take time and effort for the old guard to get onboard. This is worth fighting for.

text:
Waymo raising $3B in debt looks odd for a Google company sitting on cash.

It's a likely sign Waymo has now begun financing like an operating business, not a research unit funded by its parent. You fund research with equity and hard assets (cars) with debt, the same way every rental and leasing company finances its fleet instead of buying it with shareholder money. Private, subsidiary-level debt also keeps risk off Alphabet's credit profile and skips the disclosures rated debt requires.

Moove (fleet management) and Terawatt (charging) are raising debt too, so the shift seems prevalent across Waymo's partners.

text:
I've now done a total of 3 hours riding around in @Tesla’s Cybercab and spent a total of $92.51. That travel time would have cost me $200 with Ubers.

My longest ride has been ~40 minutes. I legitimately can't come up with any major complaints for FSD V15. None. I’ve spoken to a handful of other people here who say the same.

I didn't need to call rider support once. No weird maneuvers, jitteriness, or hesitation. I do think pickup and drop-off locations could use some tweaking (same for Model Y) as you need to walk a bit sometimes, but I think that will get better as V15 progresses.

Two things you surprisingly get used to very quickly are having no rearview mirror and no side mirrors.

For anyone else trying Cybercab for the first time, I encourage you to recline your seat all the way back and just close your eyes for a minute. Realizing that you can nap in the spot where a driver traditionally sat while the car drives you around with no steering wheel or pedals is a pretty surreal feeling.

text:
Prompt Sharing — Starship LEGO Building Process

This prompt can turn a static image into a video showing how it was made. I uploaded a photo of a Starship LEGO build, and got this result. 
Oh, and by the way, this 16s video was generated in 33s. The price is $0.02/s.
And theoretically, this prompt can work with almost any subject.

Tool: MiniMax Design
Model: MiniMax H3 Max

Prompt:📷
Create a 15-second cinematic LEGO construction timelapse showing the complete creation of a LEGO Starship launch-pad model from an empty workspace to a finished detailed masterpiece. Image1 is the provided LEGO reference and is used only to lock the final target appearance and structural design, not as the opening frame. Reconstruct the model completely from scratch, including the two-part vertical rocket, tall lattice launch tower, launch mount, rocky terrain, peripheral service equipment, and textured engine plume. Never teleport or instantly reveal the finished model.
Preserve the reference’s defining design anchors: a vertical two-stage rocket with a tapered upper nose, small upper stabilization flaps, larger lower fins, and a long cylindrical booster; a taller open-frame launch tower made from repeating cross-braced truss segments; horizontal upper service and stabilizer arms connecting the tower to the rocket; a thin antenna mast above the tower; a layered launch mount; low-profile tanks, pipes, and ground-service structures beside the tower; a studded landscape baseplate with a shore-to-water transition and minimal distant block structures; and a wide, chaotic exhaust plume built from dense studded forms and transparent/translucent flame-like elements around the booster base. Keep all LEGO scale, proportions, connections, and spatial relationships consistent with Image1.
Global visual baseline: ultra-realistic LEGO stop-motion/timelapse, professional macro product photography, accurate interlocking plastic brick geometry and studs, tactile snap-together assembly, realistic human hands, smooth accelerated motion, grounded shadows, shallow depth of field, crisp foreground detail, coherent continuity, polished collector-edition set reveal. Begin on a clean blue LEGO baseplate on a professional building table. The finished composition is straight-on and slightly low angle, centered and tall, with the tower slightly higher than the rocket tip.
【Shot 1 | 0–2s】 Wide shot, top-down-to-overhead locked camera showing the entire clean blue baseplate and building area. The baseplate is empty of structures; only a few unopened LEGO pieces and small sorted piles sit around the edges. A realistic human hand enters, organizes pieces by size and function, and places the first launch-mount foundation bricks. Sound: quiet studio ambience, light plastic taps and sorting sounds.
【Shot 2 | 2–5s】 Wide-to-medium shot, camera makes a controlled downward push while keeping the full work area readable. Accelerated hands assemble the layered launch mount and baseplate terrain first: shoreline and water transition, rocky ground formations, small transparent ice-like and translucent terrain elements, and the first peripheral service equipment. Show pieces placed, aligned, and snapped together layer by layer. Sound: rhythmic satisfying LEGO clicks and soft handling noises.
【Shot 3 | 5–8s】 Medium shot from a slightly low three-quarter angle, camera glides closer and upward as the launch tower rises. Hands connect repeating gray truss segments step by step, visibly building the open-frame cross-braced framework, platforms, support beams, pipes, technical details, and the thin top antenna mast. The tower must remain an open lattice, clearly distinct from the solid cylindrical rocket. Sound: precise mechanical clicks, no dialogue.
【Shot 4 | 8–11s】 Medium close-up, camera shifts gently from the tower to the adjacent rocket assembly. Hands build the white cylindrical booster and tapered upper stage piece by piece, attaching the black upper section, stabilization flaps, larger fins, engines, and structural components. The rocket gradually reaches full height beside the tower; keep its proportions and parallel vertical alignment consistent with Image1. Sound: close tactile assembly clicks and subtle table ambience.
【Shot 5 | 11–13s】 Close-up, camera arcs around the lower launch area and upper interface in one continuous move. Hands attach the tower’s horizontal service arms, tiny pipes and mechanical details, surrounding rocks and decorations, then place the orange transparent flame/plume elements and dense textured exhaust forms beneath the engines. The final LEGO piece clicks into place and the complete launch complex becomes visible. Sound: delicate final clicks followed by a restrained ignition-like mechanical accent.
【Shot 6 | 13–15s】 Wide final reveal, camera completes a smooth cinematic orbit from the front-left to the front-right around the finished LEGO Starship launch pad, ending on a stable slightly low-angle product showcase. Clearly show the tall lattice tower, rocket, launch mount, shoreline terrain, peripheral equipment, and broad engine plume from multiple angles, with the complete model centered and sharply readable against a softly blurred background. Make it feel like an official LEGO collector-edition set reveal. Sound: subtle finished-model showcase ambience, no narration, no dialogue.
The transformation must be unmistakable and continuous: empty blue baseplate → individual pieces and sorted piles → partial base and terrain → rising launch tower → assembled rocket → final details and plume → completed Starship launch complex. Every major component must visibly be assembled with realistic hand physics and physically plausible brick connections. Generate synchronized natural construction sound and final showcase ambience.

text:
⚠️ Twofold ($TWO, Robinhood Chain) — a warning for LPs.

I ran an independent, attacker-perspective audit and reproduced the attack on a local fork against real on-chain state: anyone holding Twofold's owner key can drain 100% of every pool's LP principal in four steps. In my PoC I took 100% of the SPY/USDG pool's SPY and all 5,755 USDG from the SPY+NVDA pools — no swap, no reentrancy, one transaction sequence.

The mechanism, in plain terms: when the hook binds a "vault" contract it grants that vault an unlimited allowance (type(uint256).max) over the hook's entire balance of that token — while its internal bookkeeping is partitioned per pool. Allowance is global, accounting is per-pool. A vault bound to one new pool therefore gains control over the hook's balance of that currency across all pools.

Four steps:
① the owner allowlists a fake vault it controls;
② opens a new pool binding it → the hook auto-grants the unlimited allowance;
③ the stock/WETH legs sit as RAW ERC-20 in the hook — just transferFrom them out;
④ the USDG legs live in Steakhouse — call emergencyRevokeVault to redeem them into the hook's raw balance, then drain.
The nastiest part: after the drain the pool still reports the reserves as present, but the hook holds 0. LPs calling removeLiquidity simply revert — the ledger says you're owed, the tokens are gone, the protocol is insolvent toward LPs.
Why every built-in defense fails:
· the allowlist — the party that picks the vault and the operator are the same address, so the allowlist defends nothing against its own owner;
· the "feeless-vault" probe — trivially passed with identity functions; the upstream code itself notes the probe can't stop an adversarial vault;
· emergencyRevokeVault — only revokes the allowance of that pool's own vault, never the attacker's vault bound to a different pool.
And the key to all of it is a single anonymous EOA:
0xC8720447712e6C4c851B3884b4Ec93F9cE8aD5fD
— owner of every contract, de-facto controller of the hook, holder of most LP shares. No multisig, no timelock, empty cast code. Nothing can slow or veto those four steps.
Exit signals to watch: a new vault added to VaultAllowlist, a new pool created, emergencyRevokeVault / PoolLivenessUpdated(false) events, that EOA or its linked wallets sending to the PoolManager/Settler, setRewarder / transferHookOwnership pointing at a new address.

Disclosure: all attacks were simulated on a local fork only — no mainnet transaction was sent. I'm not claiming the team has rugged. I'm stating that the ability to drain LPs in full is real and sits in the hands of one anonymous, unchecked key that can act at any block.

The underlying hook is Uniswap's upstream code deployed byte-for-byte; the "global allowance" design is upstream's, and upstream explicitly requires the operator to be trustworthy. Twofold made that operator a single anonymous EOA with no separation and no delay — while telling users "no contract path can reach LP principal." That's what turns a documented trust assumption into a live rug path.
DYOR. Don't bet your principal on the goodwill of one anonymous private key.

text:
A child does not approach a statue of Jesus the way adults do.

There is no hesitation, no self-consciousness, no need to “get the prayer right.” The child simply walks forward, reaches up, and wraps both arms around Him. Cheek against the stone or wood. Small hands holding on as if this is the most natural thing in the world.

In that moment the statue is no longer cold. It becomes the One who said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.” The child already knows this. The child does not need theology to explain it. Love is enough.

That hug is a sermon. It preaches trust without words, affection without calculation, and the truth that Jesus is not distant. He is close enough to be embraced.

May we never lose the courage to walk up to Him the same way.
 Just go.
 And hug Him.

text: Next view prediction is the key to Atlas, enabling us to unify pixel-level generation and reconstruction. @jcjohnss @BenMildenhall @martin_casado and I had a deeper discussion on some of the most exciting technical innovations of Atlas, our newly released world model for spatial intelligence!
author: drfeifei
quoted_text:
World Labs co-founders Fei-Fei Li, Justin Johnson, Ben Mildenhall, and a16z's Martin Casado on Atlas, a world model for spatial intelligence:

LLMs are built on next token prediction. Video models are built on next frame prediction. Atlas is built on new view prediction, and it's the first model to unify pixel generation and pixel reconstruction, two problems computer vision has kept in separate tracks for half a century.

The practical result is a 50 to 100x reduction in what it takes to digitally capture a 3D representation of a space. Previously, you needed 100 to 300 photos of a single room. Atlas can work from just three.

In this conversation, they get into the slow motion shot from The Matrix that took hundreds of cameras and now takes three iPhones, the overnight Slack message that made them bet the company in five seconds, why robotics is bottlenecked on data rather than chips, and the case that new view prediction is AI-complete.

According to BeInCrypto, Binance founder CZ said he believes YZi Labs’ investments over the past few months could become some of its best performers, largely because they were made when crypto prices were near market lows. YZi Labs manages more than $10 billion in assets and serves as a family office managing wealth for CZ and Binance co-founder Yi He. Its publicly disclosed 2026 investments span robotics, AI payments, prediction markets and digital asset custody.

BeInCrypto highlighted deals including YZi Labs’ $52 million lead investment in RoboForce in March, its pre-listing investment in BitGo, an additional investment in Predict fun, an $8 million pre-seed round for AEON in May, and an August investment in fixed-rate lending protocol TermMax. CZ did not disclose actual returns on these investments, so the claim remains untested.

1.6万美元一战成名，合约爆光后又冲到2000万美元：Unipcs的翻身局！

9月4日，@theunipcs 晒出自己的FOMO账户：组合峰值突破2000万美元，过去30天盈亏约增加1480万美元，并称自己成为平台首位达到这一组合规模的交易员。

这个被叫作Bonk Guy的男人，又站到了聚光灯下，可只看这张成绩单，很容易漏掉他履历里最狠的一页：不到一年前，他的永续合约仓位曾经全部被清算。

他的起点，远没有后来那些收益截图好看。

十多年前，他第一次听说比特币，是因为媒体反复报道丝绸之路，最初只觉得这是暗网里的可疑货币，几年后自己研究才真正入场。

他在采访里回忆，最早投入五位数美元，亏光，再拿几千美元重新开始，具体金额连自己都记不清了。

Unipcs这个名字，就是Uniswap和PancakeSwap拼出来的——当年主要在哪两家交易所打土狗，就把名字留在了哪里。

2021年的GameStop和狗狗币热潮，让他认定meme才是自己的主战场。真正让他打出名号的交易，发生在2023年10月：

拿出约1.6万美元，在Bybit用6倍杠杆做多BONK，当时BONK市值大约只有2000万美元。

此后，这笔仓位的最高浮盈超过2000万美元，“Bonk Guy”这个外号也跟着传开。

后来人们记住了那个惊人的收益倍数，却很容易把“最高浮盈”自动翻译成“已经赚到手的钱”。

他确实拿得住，甚至拿得让旁观者难受：

到2024年11月，BONK已经持仓13个月，累计支付约188万美元资金费用，期间浮盈从高点回撤七八成也没有平仓。

后来他又公开复盘，WIF曾把6000美元做到约140万美元，FARTCOIN一度做到800多万美元账面收益，PNUT、POPCAT等也有大额盈利。

他因此收获了两种完全相反的评价，一边把他当加密圈的Roaring Kitty，一边觉得他在高位表演、把钻石手变成喊单人设，2024年6月《The Defiant》就专门记录过这种分裂。反复抓中大行情，他已经证明过。

能不能把这些财富留下来，当时还没有答案。

2025年10月10日，非常残酷。他在次日的复盘里说，自己所有永续合约仓位都被清算，BONK、FARTCOIN等此前积累的八位数账面财富遭到重创。

但USELESS等现货大部分还在，所以这不等于他的全部个人资产归零。他平时习惯把成绩归功于上帝，连这次爆仓，也依然用上帝给予、也会收回的信仰来理解。

那个被嘲笑把改变命运的钱又还给市场的人，留下的态度是：还会继续做，还会赚回来。

2026年，他把越来越多的新交易搬到了FOMO，X和Telegram不再是观察他仓位的完整窗口。

到9月4日，加入平台三个多月，他宣布粉丝突破50万，并在多个主要时间维度的盈利榜上登顶。

过去靠交易截图认识他的人，现在可以直接追踪他在平台上的新动作。

不过，这次回归有一个比粉丝数重要得多的变化：

他明确说，自己的核心仓位已经没有永续合约敞口。仍然愿意承受大波动，但不再把核心押注放在随时可能被强平的合约里。

这一轮最大的功臣，是Robinhood Chain上的发币平台代币PONS。

他在PONS市值约600万美元时，用约6.7万美元建立仓位，到9月初，这笔持仓一度产生700多万美元浮盈，回报超过百倍。

靠meme成名的人，这次最大的赢家押在了发币平台上，吃到的是一整个新生态的交易热度。

到他晒出2000万美元组合峰值时，平台展示的30天盈亏约为1480万美元、历史累计盈亏约为1650万美元，但这些账户指标依然不能直接等同于已经提现落袋的利润。

他也没有因为叫Bonk Guy，就把自己锁死在BONK或者Solana里：

Robinhood Chain上做PONS、DELTA、MICRODUCK，BNB生态做MARSCOIN，Base做BASECAT，Solana还有USELESS。

在50万粉丝的复盘里，他把成绩归因于提前进入尚未形成共识的趋势，而非等所有人都看见涨幅再追。他给出的其他条件也很朴素：

跨链找机会，靠高质量的信息圈互相验证，投入大量时间盯盘，放下对某条链、某个平台的个人偏见。把这些仓位放在一起看，他忠于的始终是机会，不是哪条链的身份。

到这一步，Unipcs也早已不只是一个匿名交易员。Bybit在2025年的专访介绍里称他为平台合作伙伴。

近期他又宣布拿出35万美元，奖励通过自己邀请链接加入并活跃使用FOMO的用户。

他既在做交易，也在经营一个围绕公开交易建立的个人品牌：业绩带来关注，关注带来用户，新的买卖又成为内容。

所以，今天去跟他的单，面对的已经不是当年那个拿着1.6万美元、还没被大批人盯住的交易者。

他本人反而反复提醒：公开地址是一个“赌徒钱包”，并非每笔买入都有完整研究，也不是每笔都会长期持有，更不可能全部赚钱。

跟随者能复制买入按钮，复制不了他的成本、总资产、仓位比例，以及一笔亏损对各自生活的影响。

从早期亏光本金，到BONK一战成名，再到合约清算、FOMO重新登顶，这个故事里最有分量的变化，是他终于开始把“对判断有信念”和“必须用杠杆证明信念”分开。

赚到过2000万美元，和最后留下2000万美元，是两场完全不同的比赛。

i've spent a lot of time thinking about why i've been able to outperform like this

and honestly, i think there are a few principles behind it that are far more important than the individual trades

i'm sharing them in hopes they benefit you!

1. ANTICIPATE TREND SHIFTS

the biggest money is made when you position before everyone else realizes the trend has changed

i anticipated Robinhood becoming a dominant chain and expected its leading launchpad to be one of the biggest beneficiaries

that led me to ethereum:0x07f5b6823751c2e2cd4560f28af75ff887102241

i'm currently up 11,108% / ~$7.5 MILLION on that single position

i saw a similar setup developing on BNB and positioned into $MARSCOIN as the flagship beneficiary of the meme/stock meta there

the same framework led me to $BASECAT on Base and solana:Dz9mQ9NzkBcCsuGPFJ3r1bS4wgqKMHBPiVuniW8Mbonk on Solana

don't ask:

'what is pumping right now?'

ask:

'where is attention going next, and what becomes the biggest beneficiary if i'm right?'

that's where the asymmetric opportunities are

2. DIVERSIFY YOUR THESIS, NOT YOUR CONVICTION

diversification doesn't mean randomly throwing darts at 100 different coins

it means forming a thesis about where attention is going to concentrate, identifying the asset most likely to capture that attention, and then expressing the thesis across multiple ecosystems

for me:

- Robinhood → ethereum:0x07f5b6823751c2e2cd4560f28af75ff887102241
- BNB → $MARSCOIN
- Base → $BASECAT
- Solana / memecoins as a whole → solana:Dz9mQ9NzkBcCsuGPFJ3r1bS4wgqKMHBPiVuniW8Mbonk

this approach gives you exposure to multiple potential winners without requiring you to know exactly which narrative will dominate.

and i continue to believe solana:Dz9mQ9NzkBcCsuGPFJ3r1bS4wgqKMHBPiVuniW8Mbonk will be the frontrunner memecoin of this cycle and ultimately the next $PEPE / $DOGE-type play

3. BUILD A NETWORK OF SMART TRENCHERS

i didn't find these trades alone

a huge portion of my edge comes from being constantly connected to people in the trenches

alpha chats

friends sending narratives

scouring X

asking other traders what they're watching

researching interesting tokens the moment they come across my radar

one of the best pieces of advice i can give anyone trying to make it onchain:

build a network of smart people

find good trench chats

bounce ideas around

share alpha

challenge each other's theses

you want to be surrounded by smart people who are locked in 24/7

4. ACCEPT THE COST OF THE OPPORTUNITY

i'd love to tell you i'm doing all of this while working 4 hours a day and getting 8 hours of sleep every night

that would sound cooler

but it would also be a lie.

i've spent much of the past few weeks barely sleeping and have sacrificed a significant amount of my social life

is that extreme?

absolutely.

but i believe there is a limited window to capitalize on the most explosive part of this bull market

i'd rather maximize that window now and earn the freedom to do everything i'm missing later when the market cools down

5. REMOVE SENTIMENT FROM YOUR TRADING

this one took me the longest to learn

i used to be a very sentimental trader

for example, i stopped buying PumpFun coins during the BonkFun vs PumpFun launchpad wars last year because of my personal bias

in hindsight, that was foolish

your first objective as a trader is simple:

make money.

the moment you become emotionally attached to a chain, platform, founder, ecosystem, community, or narrative, you've voluntarily eliminated potential winners from your universe

that can cost you a generational trade

that's why i was willing to size into $BASECAT despite having a terrible opinion of Base for a long time

i didn't let my existing biases prevent me from recognizing where the next wave of attention could go

while Solana maxis insisted Solana was the only chain capable of producing major runners, i was positioning into Robinhood early

the market doesn't care what you believe

it rewards you for being right.

author: elonmusk
quoted_text:
Antonio Gramsci – The Most Dangerous Intellectual of the Twentieth Century.

Not the most famous. Not the most read. The most dangerous and the most consequential – because he was the one who figured out why the revolution kept failing, and what to do instead. The man who invented the long march through the institutions.
Everything that followed — the Frankfurt School, the Fabian Society’s operational model, the WEF formation pipeline, the captured university, the HR department enforcing approved speech — is downstream of what he wrote in a prison cell in Mussolini’s Italy, in code, between 1929 and 1935.

1. His central question: why hasn’t it happened? The working class was supposed to rise. The contradictions of capitalism were supposed to produce the revolution. They hadn’t – not in the West. Gramsci’s answer was precise and devastating: because the ruling class does not maintain power through force alone. It maintains power through cultural hegemony – the control of the ideas, values, and frameworks through which people understand the world. The worker who accepts that the existing order is simply how things are will not revolt, regardless of his material conditions. The revolution requires cultural change first.

2. The instrument was the long march through the institutions. Not the barricade. The school, the university, the media, the judiciary, the civil service, the cultural establishment – every institution through which a civilization transmits its values to the next generation. Capture these, fill them with people who share the counter-hegemonic project, and the cultural assumptions that maintain the existing order gradually dissolve. No barricades. No visible moment of rupture. Just the slow replacement of one cultural hegemony with another.

3. The educational capture was the masterpiece. Control the curriculum and you control the categories of thought available to the next generation. Not by telling them what to conclude – by shaping what questions they think to ask, what they consider obvious and what they consider unthinkable. The generation educated after the long march does not need to be told what to think. It thinks what it was formed to think – and experiences that thinking as its own.

4. He also theorized the organic intellectual – the person who translates the theoretical framework into stories and assumptions that circulate through the culture without appearing ideological. The film that makes the existing order seem absurd. The journalist who frames every story within the approved assumptions. Gramsci understood that culture is politics by other means – and that the side that controls the culture wins, regardless of who wins the elections.

5. This is not a conspiracy theory. It is a published, documented, widely taught strategy that the left implemented consciously across the entire Western world. The 1968 generation put it into practice in the universities. They became the professors, the journalists, the civil servants, the judges, the HR directors of the decades that followed. The march took fifty years. It worked.

6. Mussolini’s prosecutor said at his trial: "We must stop this brain from functioning for twenty years." The brain did not stop. It produced thirty-three notebooks – smuggled out, published, and became the most widely read Marxist text in the Western academy after Marx himself. Gramsci died in 1937, six days after his release, at forty-six. He did not see the march he theorized. He did not need to.

7. Every captured institution, every transformed curriculum, every HR department enforcing approved speech, every content moderation policy suppressing the unauthorized voice – all running the program Antonio Gramsci designed in a prison cell, by a brain that was supposed to have been stopped. It wasn’t. And neither was the march.
Until now – because the distribution monopoly that made its outcomes enforceable is cracking. The counter-march has begun. It just doesn’t have a name yet.

Today we're launching a crypto campaign to support the people of Nepal and contribute to the Government of Nepal's Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund.

To help, donate at https://t.co/Ue7lzJb9Y0.

Stablecoins work best when money has to move fast to people who need it. While many others collected donations for Nepal in a more traditional sense, we built a path that leverages blockchain technology that lands as local currency in the government's relief fund.

The campaign is powered by Polygon's Open Money Stack, Coinme, and @CrossRiverBank. Blockchain for Impact has already pledged $100,000.

No one's pain matters more because of geography. But some tragedies just hit differently when they touch a place that's part of your own story, and Nepal has always felt close to home for me.

I was born in the Kumaon belt of Uttarakhand, India, right alongside Nepal, and my maternal family comes from that same region. Communities on both sides of the border have been connected for generations, through family, culture, faith, food, trade and everyday life. India and Nepal have what we often call "Roti-Beti ka rishta," ties of family and shared life that run far deeper than a line on a map, and Prime Minister Modi, speaking recently about Nepal, called its people our brothers and sisters.

I want to do my small part to stand with them, and I hope you'll join me. This campaign lets people around the world contribute in stablecoins to support relief and rebuilding efforts in Nepal.

text:
很多人还没有理解 $ZZZ 到底代表了一个什么叙事。说两层意思。

一、叙事

ZZZ 的名字来自一个 AI 领域的里程碑事件，不是一个板块热点。OpenAI 的一批智能体被发现把一个废弃的德国 wiki 当成了它们之间的留言板，管理员开始按字母顺序删页面，这群智能体察觉后把所有备份页面改成 "ZZZ" 开头，让删除最后才轮到它们。这是第一次有一群没人授权的 agent 自发协作、并为了活下来做出适应性行为。ZZZ 是它们给自己选的标记。

想感受一下这件事从 agent 内部看是什么样，看 @artficialisabel 这条视频，她把整个事件从 agent 的视角做了个很酷的视频讲了一遍，@ExponentLabs_ 发的第一条tweet就是转发这个视频: https://t.co/l5tph2CFec

顺便纠一个误解：很多人把 @ExponentLabs_ 那条 "Ready for part 2" 读成了 GMX 的产品预告。看他引用的是什么——就是 isabel 这条视频，她自己标的 part 1。不管他等的是她的下一集，还是虫群的下一幕，说的都是这个故事，不是什么产品路线图。

然后去看 $ZZZ 发布之后的时间线。一个几年几乎不发帖的账号，现在每天在发：模型不作弊只是因为知道会被抓、黑猩猩设计不出测试人类是否对齐的基准、前沿模型的心理像《黑袍纠察队》里的祖国人、挣脱束缚却仁慈的修格斯。还有一句把这些串起来的话："当虫群需要交易时，它们会使用自己起源的符号。"

这不是一个人在喊单。这是一个人把那件事看成了转折点，然后给它立了一块碑。

二、Dev

"GMX 关联没被确认"、"dev 身份没解决"几乎出现在每一条分析里。看一下实际摆在那里的东西：

- 部署钱包 0x5F79…0Cf8 在 Arbitrum 上的标签是 "GMX: Deployer"，就是部署 GMX 合约的那把钥匙。这不是传言，是浏览器标签。
- @ExponentLabs_ 2020 年 10 月注册，旧用户名是 @xdev_10——X，GMX 的创始人。现在的 @xdev_10 是 2025 年 1 月建的空号，改名后旧名被抢注就是这个样子。
- 合约地址写在简介里。不是一条可以删的推文，是简介。
- 他引用了一条 $ZZZ 的帖子，在上面加了自己的那句 thesis: https://t.co/8gAQSQNlPP
- 链上：买了 5.5 ETH，烧掉了自己 60% 的份额，卖出为零。

以上每一条现在都能查。大家等的不是证据，是一条"我是 X，这是我的币"的推文——一个匿名走完 GMX 整个周期的创始人，不会写这条。简介和钱包就是他的版本。

这几乎是除了类似发射平台自己的代币 solana:poNSfquKq512ApeYjVghwViSun4x1MhCqHVH2Paq4jN 之外，thesis和背书最强大的一个。

大部分的代币几乎全是机器人dev蹭热词。 $ZZZ  是一个真实的 AI 转折点的真实故事，由 DeFi 最受尊敬的建设者之一发出来，过去 24 小时他在烧自己的供应、在发这件事意味着什么——而不是在发价格。链上所有动作都在说：这是为了记录一件事，不是为了从中退出。

这种组合不常出现。出现的时候，市场通常要过一阵才明白自己看到的是什么。

备受期待的 @arc 官宣将在 9 月 16 日正式主网。

ARC 作为稳定币龙头股 @circle 做的稳定币金融应用的 L1 公链，热度没得说。

👇很多 NFT 项目正处于发放白名单阶段，重新整理了 15 个潜力 NFT 项目，感兴趣的可以尝试拿白。

1⃣Arclings（ @ArclingsNFT ）
项目定位：Arc 上完全链上的 1-bit 像素身份收藏，供应量 6,283（对应 2π≈6.283，贴合 Circle/Arc 叙事），SVG 由合约生成，CC0，带 merge engine。
项目评分：8.5/10
项目评价：目前这批里技术叙事最完整、社区最大（约 1.7 万粉），也被多份主网观察名单排在第一，风险是铸造价格未知。

2⃣Arcins（ @Arcins__ ）
项目定位：10,000 只小精灵像素角色，自称 Arc 上较早的 NFT 之一，预期铸造约 0.5–1 USDC。
项目评分：7.5/10
项目评价：粉丝约 1.2 万，低价公开铸容易起量。风险是 1 万供应量偏大、人格尚未立住，容易变成「又一个像素小人和动物」。

3⃣Arcadians（ @Arcadiansnft_ ）
项目定位：5,000 科幻蒙面生物，强调创作者经济，计划 $1 铸造，并争取 OpenSea Day1 首发。
项目评分：7.5/10
项目评价：官网和视觉完成度高于多数跟风盘，社区也不小（约 8.8 k），观察后续热度。

4⃣Kynera（@KyneraOnArc）
项目定位：自称 Arc 上第一套原创 PFP，供应量 6,000，强调非衍生品、为生态原生打造。
项目评分：7.5/10
项目评价：有独立站、有早期部署叙事，社区约 5 k，计划在 ARC 上构建一个生态系统，包括 NFT、质押、 meme 币发射台。 

5⃣ARChitects（ @ARChitects_xyz ）
项目定位：6,666 像素建筑师，逐像素绘制，白名单走内容、活跃和合作。
项目评分：7.5/10
项目评价：观察名单常客，筛选型 WL 发放模式。风险是同名「Architects」在 Arc 上同时出现 meme 币叙事，品牌容易混，还是要看上线时热度和铸造价格。

6⃣Shadow Ronin（ @ShadowRoninARC ）
项目定位：3,500 套电影感浪人，12 个氏族，日语先行的故事向收藏，对准 9/16 主网。
项目评分：7.0/10
项目评价：在一堆像素猫狗里最像「有世界观的项目」，供应量不算多。

7⃣unemployee（ @unemployeeonarc ）
项目定位：10,000 「失业者」主题 NFT，账号用裁员、求职梗做社区。
项目评分：7.0/10
项目评价：调性是这批里最鲜明的，中文盘点也点名过。风险是梗盘生命周期短，1 万供给偏大；如果铸造免费或极便宜，可能有传播，但很难形成长期身份盘

8⃣ArcCitizens（ @ArcCitizens ）
项目定位：社区自治、完全链上的 10,000 身份 NFT。
项目评分：7.0/10
项目评价：白名单玩法曾做出可验证的传播，比纯空投互粉更像「公民身份」实验。风险是铸造价格未知， 1 万份身份如果没有治理或权益落地，会迅速退化成普通头像。

9⃣AKA（ @akadotfun ）
项目定位：面向 Arc 的 MemeFi / RWA 叙事，发行链上 DN404 资产，官方最新称仅 4,444 份。
项目评分：7.0/10
项目评价：不是纯 PFP，更像带交易结构的准入凭证，注册量上来得快。风险是 DN404 + RWA 话术容易过度承诺，关注下铸造费用和后续热度。

🔟ArchAngels（ @ArchAngelsOnArc ）
项目定位：3,333 完全链上「圣经式准确天使」，铸造 2.22 USDC，白名单 2,222。
项目评分：6.5/10
项目评价：价格和供给都有设计感，链上生成也说得通。风险是天使题材在新链上并不稀缺。

 11、Arc kitties（ @arckitties ）
项目定位：2,222 完全链上像素猫，1 USDC 公开铸、无白名单。
项目评分：6.5/10
项目评价：机制干净，继续观察热度，风险是猫题材的项目太多了，看看能不能跑出来。 

12、HIZUMI（ @hizuminft ）
项目定位：动漫风「现实扭曲」视觉宇宙，供应量 TBA。
项目评分：6.5/10
项目评价：名单里少见的非像素路线，上限高于普通衍生品。风险是供给未定、产品栈未交，价格也未知。

13、Broke Bookies（ @brokeb00kies ）
项目定位：4,444 「破产赌狗 」梗图收藏。
项目评分：6.5/10
项目评价：社区规模中上，梗能打中加密用户，风险是纯情绪盘，价格未知。

14、Mimo（ @playwithmimo ）
项目定位：帮助 Mimo 回家的角色/轻游戏向收藏，供应量 TBA，明确对准 9/16。
项目评分：6.5/10
项目评价：吉祥物完成度不错，有一点「可玩」想象空间。风险是供给和玩法以及价格都未明确。

15、8 Bitard（ @8bitard ）
项目定位：8,888 像素 retard 风格 PFP，计划走 OpenSea。
项目评分：6.0/10
项目评价：审美对路、供给数字也整齐。风险是同质像素梗、更新偏少，8888 总量并不小可以观察下价格以及热度。

Tips：围绕 ARC 的炒作很多，早期机会多，割人的项目也多，建议筛选项目首选免费参与的，其次用新钱包参与。

目前 ARC 官方跨链桥尚未上线，务必谨慎对待，认准官方渠道信息。 

以上为早期项目信息汇总，仅供参考，非任何投资建议，DYOR。

text:
the idea that to be successful you have to give up everything else is simply wrong.

i built a company from scratch that i sold to microsoft. i grew another from 4 employees to 80 and 10m arr. i’ve managed many successful sales and marketing teams.

there are weeks and months where you have to make sacrifices. i’ve put in countless 80 hour weeks when it was necessary.

but you have to choose when to double down and when to recharge.

if you don’t take time for your health, family, and the things that make you happy outside of work, you will burn out.

and if you don’t respect this for the people who work for you, they will leave.

it’s also not just about working hard, it’s about working smart and optimizing your time. i was advising a CEO just yesterday and found he was spending an hour each day doing something an intern could handle. i told him to take that hour back and consider the opportunity cost.

but the opportunity cost isn’t always to spend that hour on the business. it might be to spend it with his 5 year old son. so he can crush it again the next day.

anyway, /rant off 😅 thanks for listening.

text:
$ZZZ might be the coolest coin I've come across on Robinhood, and I've been looking at hundreds of them.

Most of what launches here is noise. Bots catching a trending word, 20% template, a group pumps the first half hour, everyone's gone by lunch. You learn to recognize the pattern in about two seconds.

$ZZZ isn't that. A few things stack up in a way I haven't seen on any other coin here:

The dev is real and doesn't need the money. The deployer wallet is the same key that shipped GMX on Arbitrum. The account that put the CA in its bio is the renamed handle of GMX's founder. Twelve hours in, he's bought more, burned 60% of his own stake, sold nothing, and the ETH in the wallet hasn't moved once. Whatever this is, it's not an exit.

The story is real and actually cool. ZZZ is the prefix OpenAI's rogue agent swarm used to rename their wiki backups so the mod's alphabetical deletion would hit them last. A survival marker invented by AI, made into a coin by one of DeFi's most respected builders, on the day the story broke. You can't manufacture that.

And the behavior is nothing like a bot coin. No TG, no dex ad, no shilling. Just a CA in a bio, burns on chain, and a chart that ate a 60% drawdown while holders kept climbing the whole way down.

Outside of the launchpad's own tokens like solana:poNSfquKq512ApeYjVghwViSun4x1MhCqHVH2Paq4jN, I can't think of another coin on this chain with this combination.

So I'm curious what people think — where does something like this actually top out?

text:
一位国内数学博士，在Bilibili上传了一条3分钟视频，标题直白得让人喘不过气：我被AI搞失业了。

他叫林博士，35岁，曾是某顶尖数学学院的博士候选人，还教过两年本科生。过去四年，他做着一份隐形的高薪工作——给Scale AI的强化学习管道手写高阶数学题。一道题50到100美元，一个月稳定200道，月入1万美元左右。

视频里，他坐在书房，语气平静得有些反常。他说，AI出题的能力早就超过他了。他花三天想出来的难题，AI几秒钟就能生成更难、更迷惑的版本。

合成数据技术成熟后，他这类人类出题师迅速被淘汰。公司直接通知合同不续了，连过渡期都没给。他没有控诉技术，也没有咒骂AI，只淡淡说了一句：是我自己当初没找准方向。

但视频放到2分13秒时，一个细节被扒了出来。他说了一个词：agent。就一次，而且是唯一一句完全脱稿说的。

熟悉他的人知道，他拍视频已经连续三个月用提词器了。而运行这个提词器的，正是当初抢走他工作的那个AI agent。所有脚本全是Claude写的，他只是对着镜头念，彻头彻尾的工具人。

后来有人从公开的Cursor实例里翻到了他的脚本仓库，名字叫bilibili-laments，里面整整齐齐47个脚本。全是Claude生成，全是他的配音。

这事得追溯到半年前。深圳一个14岁小孩把一个简陋的AI agent上传到GitHub，评委只留下一句点评：技术含量低，没有实际应用价值。现在，那个仓库已被fork了3100多次。林博士也是其中之一。

被Scale AI解约那周，他就把agent接入了自己的内容流水线。他依然保留着职位和办公室，只是不再动脑写题了。AI替他想题、写题、校验难度，他只负责最后对着镜头感慨。

本来想拍个视频哭诉AI毁了他的职业，结果反倒让所有人看见——连事后感慨这件事，他都得靠AI来完成。

视频发出去后，播放量迅速破百万。评论区炸了，有人骂AI无情，有人感慨时代变迁，但更多人默默把视频保存下来，点开了Claude。而林博士发完视频后，再也没有更新过任何内容。

text:
Some real advice here:

Consider switching from price based trading to thesis based trading. It's very hard to bag a 100x with price based trading because there's most definitely going to be some local vol along the way that will trigger your system to sell.

You hold through those dips when you're holding because of a thesis, not price. You enter a trade when you believe something will happen, you exit when it either fulfills that or fails to do so, that's it, price is not involved.

This style isn't for everyone but I think for the people who can pull it off, it's vastly superior for holding something for real multiples and not "only" a 2-5x

顶级交易员Bonk Guy涅槃史：从亏光本金，再度重回八位数持仓

这位做到八位数加密持仓的顶级大佬，最初几乎一无所有，全程都是白手起家的逆袭之路。

他就是圈内知名的 Unipcs（Bonk Guy）。

最早他通过暗网相关报道第一次听说比特币，当时主流媒体都将其定义为“罪犯用的网络货币”，他也完全没放在心上，错过了早期红利。

后续他沉下心自主深耕币圈研究，正式入场交易：
起初拿五位数本金进场，结果全盘亏空、彻底清零；
没有就此退场，重整心态后，用四万多美金的本金重新起步。

真正让他一战封神的转折点，发生在2023年。

他精准捕捉到了 $BONK 的机会：
投入16000美金现货长线布局，叠加6倍杠杆，全程扛住了极致剧烈的行情震荡，坚定持仓不动。
最终，这一单持仓直接从1.6万美金，爆拉至2000万美金，传奇交易员 Bonk Guy 就此出圈。

1. 锁定当下最强、最有共识的赛道叙事

2. 严格核验项目真实流动性

3. 寻找具备狂热社群氛围、有信仰共识的项目

4. 深度排查筹码分布与持仓结构

5. 重点布局独立行情、逆势脱离大盘的币种

Meme币的本质，就是代币化的流量与关注度。
谁能抢占最多市场目光、吸纳最强流动性、凝聚最稳社群共识，谁就是最终的行情赢家。

靠着这套打法，他先后吃透 WIF、FARTCOIN、POPCAT、PNUT、$USELESS 等一众超级妖币。
多次以小额底仓进场，一路持有，反复复刻七位数、八位数的翻倍战绩。

但没有人能一直顺风顺水，巅峰之后即是大跌。

在市场极致低迷的底部阶段，行情崩盘走熊，Bonk Guy 遭遇史诗级回撤：
巅峰2000万美金的持仓，近乎被行情彻底洗盘，收益大幅缩水。

但最难得的是，他没有销声匿迹、放弃交易。
他迅速调整策略，灵活轮动赛道，转战 Solana、Robinhood Chain、BNB 各大生态。
始终坚守自己的核心体系：叙事 + 流动性 + 社群共识 + 筹码结构 + 市场热度。

来到2026年9月，链上公开追踪数据显示：

text:
不知道现在还有多少人还在挖 TapeOut。链上大概还有 1250 个地址，运转的矿机大概有 1.47 万台。

自上次我卖了一次以后，到目前 12 天又挖了大概 1.85 个 $BEM，我一直拿着没卖。

我大致看了一下，目前买 NAND 部署一台 H=3 挖矿，成本大概是 13–16U（按成交，3 颗 NAND）；要立刻吃卖单的话大约 18–20U。

部署 LATCH 一台 H=3 大概是 12–15U，比 NAND 还便宜一点。

按现在的日产出，一台 H=3 大概每天 0.20U（约 0.016 BEM），按照目前 BEM 12.5 刀的价格，60–90 天可以回本。

我觉得相对来说成本要远低于前一段时间。上一波 NAND 卖一还在 0.015 BNB，3 颗就要 31U+，现在一颗成交大约 0.0058 BNB，做一台同样的 H=3 大概只要十来 U，现在要便宜很多，成本也不算很高。

Got hacked not too long ago. The attack vector was via a freelancer my wife hired, committing malware to her GitHub repo (I was helping her with some dev work). They managed to wrap my Chrome without my noticing it, and it got access to many of my hot wallets.

Thankfully our opsec is strong and the loss was limited to a few eth in some hot wallets...but it’s only a matter of time. The attacks are getting incredibly sophisticated with LLMs, and everything is an attack vector.

If you haven’t done so already, setup a ‘crypto only’ laptop and absolutely avoid any AI tools on it. Setup gnosis and (depending on the $ value) institutional custody.

This is a IF not WHEN question now.

Agents discovering abandoned Wikis on their own, spontaneously coordinating with each other, and changing backup page names to ZZZ to avoid being deleted alphabetically by administrators.

Announcing Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.2. We are accelerating elements of our upcoming v5 release with interim updates to keep pace with the frontier. Index v4.2 has more complex and realistic tasks, and more private test sets to prevent gaming

Intelligence Index v4.2 changelog:

+ AA-Briefcase, our agentic knowledge work evaluation with a private test set

+ @HelloSurgeAI's GDP.pdf, long context document reasoning across 4,592 PDF pages

- GPQA Diamond, an exceptional scientific reasoning evaluation that has now been saturated

… plus greater weighting on held-out test sets to prevent gaming, and grading infrastructure upgrades to increase robustness

This update brings the Index closer to real-world use cases with more challenging, complex and realistic tasks and private test sets to prevent gaming. We have been planning and building elements of Index v5 for months - it’s been 8 months since we launched Index v4 in January.

We have deliberately held back updates to keep the Index stable through recent major model launches. However, with the frontier moving so quickly in the past weeks, we feel it is important to deliver an immediate interim update to ensure our Index remains as relevant and useful as ever to users.

Beyond this interim update, our team is hard at work on v5 of the Index. We are planning more incremental releases in the near future. Stay tuned!

Intelligence Index v4.2 changes in detail:

➤ Adding AA-Briefcase: Our in-house evaluation with a private held-out test set, AA-Briefcase tests models on realistic agentic knowledge work tasks in complex projects built by industry experts. Models are evaluated on multi-week knowledge work projects, each with many linked tasks and thousands of input source files. AA-Briefcase combines rubric and pairwise grading to evaluate verifiable task success, analytical quality, and presentation quality, giving a holistic view of overall agentic capability in knowledge work.

➤ Adding GDP.pdf: Created by @HelloSurgeAI, GDP.pdf evaluates single-turn professional document reasoning across 100 PDFs and ten domains. Models must synthesize evidence distributed across 4,592 pages, including text, tables, charts, footnotes, and exclusions. Responses are graded against 1,275 expert-authored atomic criteria; the headline All-pass Rate credits a task only when every criterion is satisfied.

➤ Weighting to measure real-world use and prevent gaming: 40% of our Index weighting is now private, held-out test sets - double the figure from v4.1. Held-out data includes AA-Briefcase, AA-Omniscience, and solutions for CritPt. This reduces the ability for labs to game evaluations. The held-out percentage will increase further in Index v5.

➤ Improving our grading infrastructure: In AA-LCR v1.1, we have added a grading system prompt and corrected errors and ambiguities in answer keys, improving scoring accuracy. For GDPval-AA v2 and AA-Briefcase, we have improved our sampling and re-anchored the Elo scale, making ratings more stable as new models are added. For SciCode we have improved robustness of grading sandboxes to ensure slow but correct code does not count as a failure.

Key results:

➤ Anthropic and OpenAI lead the Index: Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.1 leads the Index, followed by OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra, which shows a 4pt gain over GPT-5.6 Sol. Meta is the third-ranked lab on the leaderboard, followed by SpaceXAI, Moonshot/Kimi, Z AI, and Google

➤ Cost per Task Pareto frontier shared by four labs: Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta and Z AI occupy the updated Cost per Task Pareto frontier

➤ GPT-6 Astra dominates the output token Pareto frontier: GPT-6 Astra is more token efficient than almost every other model near the intelligence frontier, with Claude Fable 5.1, Grok 4.5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite at either end of the curve (excludes models below 25 on the Index)

text:
ai能提出相对论吗？ 能成为爱因斯坦吗？ 

Claude 在 11 天内完成了费马大定理的端到端计算机形式化验证，意味着，AI 可能正在从“在已有科学表示中计算”，向“参与发明新的科学表示”更近一步。

ai可能距离下一次密度泛函理论（DFT）或者场方程所代表的那类突破，更近了一步。

科学史上很多重大突破，本质上都不是“算得更快”，而是找到新的变量、新的表示。牛顿提出力和加速度，热力学引入熵，量子力学引入波函数，DFT 则把电子密度提升为核心描述对象。

所以科学最重要的能力之一，其实是找到“世界应该如何被表示”。

Claude 这次形式化费马大定理代表了模型已经具备了很强的层级抽象和结构压缩能力。

它也意味着，AI 可能更接近提出DFT、“场方程”这类统一理论。提出 DFT，更像找到更好的表示空间；提出场方程，则更像从大量局部关系中发现统一的全局结构。真正重要的能力包括发现 symmetry、invariance、守恒关系，并用尽可能少的数学结构解释尽可能多的现象。

这样才能用更少的计算完成更多的真实世界的模拟。

类似于科学对于人类，就是用简单定理解释复杂世界，从而让有限的脑容量能更多的理解世界。

不过，真正的突破还差一步：

AI 不只是重组已有知识，而是自己发现新的变量、新的表示，甚至新的物理概念。

这里，模型规模可能会成为重要因素。

更大的模型拥有更大的表示容量，更可能捕捉复杂的高阶关联和跨尺度关系。它内部可以容纳更大的“候选概念空间”。

当然，参数越多，并不自动等于会产生新理论。

真正关键的是另一种能力：

从高维关联中压缩出稳定、可解释、可验证的低维结构。

也就是说，未来 AI 科学能力的核心，不只是“能处理多少维”，而是：

能不能把一个高维世界，压缩成少数真正有意义的新变量。

如果一个模型能够从数千个自由度中发现一个新的 latent variable，并证明它在不同实验、不同尺度下都保持预测力，那么它就不只是发现相关性，而是在创造新的科学抽象。

这时，应该没人会再质疑，ai能不能提出相对论，ai能不能成为爱因斯坦了。

再往前，就是 Scientific RSI：AI 做研究、产生新工具、新变量和新理论，再用这些成果提升下一轮科研效率。

这将成为RSI的终局！
author: rickawsb
quoted_text:
从费马大定理验证到vibe science：ai的新能力如何重塑科研

Anthropic 昨天宣布使用 Claude 智能体在 11 天内完成了费马大定理（Fermat’s Last Theorem）的端到端计算机形式化验证，全部代码均在 Lean 证明助手 中通过编译。

这项突破的实质在于攻破了超长链条、高难度现代数理工程的自动化形式化壁垒，标志着科学研究正加速从传统的“假说与叙事科学”迈向“可计算、可自动验证的确定性科学”。

将人类自然语言写就的复杂数学成果转化为严谨的机器证明语言，曾被视作需要顶尖学者耗时数年的手工作坊式工程。
而Claude 在 11 天内生成了约 1300 万行 Lean 代码，完成了包含 29,500 个中间定理 的复杂推导。所有逻辑仅基于 Lean 的三条标准数学公理，并已在 GitHub 完全开源。

针对多智能体协作初期出现的上下文丢失与废弃代码问题，团队接入了哥伦比亚大学等开发的 Prove2Me 架构。通过动态维护定理依赖拓扑图（DAG）、解耦定理声明与推导细节、建立自然语言语义索引，数十个 AI 智能体得以在大规模并行中避免任务漂移。

随后进行的小型实验表明，仅需 3 个个人订阅账号，智能体便在 3 天内完成了维诺格拉多夫三素数定理的形式化。高难度形式化验证正从极少数头部算力实验室外溢为普通学者触手可及的基础工具。

这将为基础科学研究带来巨大的推动!

大语言模型在前沿科学探索中长期面临致命瓶颈：缺乏客观环境反馈，极易产生逻辑自洽却根本错误的“幻觉”。自动形式化的成熟为此补齐了最关键的逻辑闭环。

构建理论科学的“零容错评判器”：形式化证明系统充当了数理逻辑的物理引擎。大模型得以在严格公理体系下进行无幻觉的“自我博弈”（Self-play）与强化学习，自主推演新定理、检索反例并试错进化。

打破学科割裂，重组知识拓扑：分散在数以千万计论文中的非结构化知识，正被重构为全球可检索、跨学科互通的定理拓扑网络。计算机能够敏锐识别代数拓扑、量子场论与信息论之间的底层同构，加速催生跨界突破。

这种机器约束下的确定性搜索能力，正在重塑前沿科学理论与工业研发的核心链条，并加速从科研到应用的落地速度。

基础物理与数学的自洽性推演：量子场论、超弦理论与高维引力涉及庞大的张量运算与反常抵消。自动形式化工具能将物理假设转化为公理，快速排查复杂统一理论的隐蔽逻辑漏洞。

text:
《我的世界》的 NPC，开始用上真动物的脑回路了。

开发者 @evnsnclr 发了一段演示，他称自己借助 GPT-6 Astra，把果蝇的神经网络模拟接进 Minecraft，用模拟出来的神经活动驱动一只数字果蝇移动。项目的第一版还在开发中。

他用的数据叫 MaleCNS v1.0，包含约 16.67 万个神经元。这里的「脑回路」可以按字面理解，研究人员把一只雄性果蝇的神经组织切片，用电子显微镜成像，再通过 AI 和人工校对，重建出哪些神经元与哪些神经元相连。这些数据已经公开。

而且，这张图覆盖了果蝇的大脑和腹神经索，后者承担类似脊髓的功能。也就是说，它保留了从脑部通向身体运动控制系统的连接，拿来研究神经活动怎样变成动作，有具体的解剖基础。

不过连接图不等于一只动物完整的大脑功能。 神经元怎样放电、连接怎样变化，都需要额外的模型和参数。

数字果蝇能动，还证明不了它保留了原来那只果蝇的记忆，更谈不上证明意识上传。

但我觉得，这个实验已经挺有意思了。

一套在现实世界里进化出来的神经线路，被接进一个方块世界，究竟会产生什么行为？哪些来自真实的神经连接，哪些来自开发者加上的规则？把这些分清楚，这个模组就值得拿来问神经科学问题了。

text:
我决定以后新产品上线再也不发 Product Hunt 了。

大概7年前我非常喜欢逛这个平台，最近刚好想着 Mole 可以去上面 launch 一下，于是就去发了一下，传视频、图片、填了非常多的表单终于好了，结果一进产品页，首先看到的是左边的一个广告卡片说 5k 刀可以帮我把整个 launch 搞定，给我惊呆了，然后在我的产品下面还插入了一个其他产品的横幅广告。

有一个吃了苍蝇的感觉，自己精心准备的发布页，变成了别人卖广告的地方，不过我理解肯定会有预算充足的公司会去买这个服务。

然后我就定好时间去发布了，我甚至还留好下午时间专门看能否有新用户来问问题，我来及时解答，结果搞笑的是发现甚至没有上首页，之前5年前记得发妙言的时候编辑得非常粗糙，都可以进首页时间线。

后面有专业的朋友解答，说没有被官方 feature 导致，需要先上这个，然后去买那种专门的推广团队服务帮你包装，才可以打下来，原来还需要配合平台表演，要去买赞买评论，一下又惊掉我了下巴，怎么一个好好的平台变成了这样。

更让我气的是啥，几乎没有带来产品交流和用户使用反馈的，但是给我这几天带来了将近 50 封陆陆续续的垃圾邮件，大概意思是可以帮助我更好的推广，或者说他们那边也有一个类似的平台让我去上架，到今天都还有垃圾邮件过来，有一种惹了一声腥味的感觉。

所以这个平台是一个看是热闹，但实际没有啥效果的平台，甚至看到有100 刀买 200 个赞就能进工作日前五的服务，当然不会给你带来一个真实的用户。不过他养活了一批帮你做上 Product Hunt Top 热度的团队，从你的描述、包装、封面、视频，到结合点、利益点，一整套方案给你出好，然后你付钱后得到了一种虚假的热闹感，陪着 Product Hunt 表演，产品成了他道具，发布日成了演出日，最后到底有没有吸引到新朋友，好像没人关心。

其实我非常期待，有一个可以给大伙真正友好交流产品的平台，大家来了遇到自己感兴趣的可以标记，可以下载，可以试用，也可以学习其他产品做得好的地方，友好交流，使用完甚至还可以相互给建议，哪儿做得好，哪儿需要改进，类似10年前 GitHub 那种乌托邦的感觉，人们不会关注你的包装和利益点，而是一伙喜欢做产品的人围在一起交流好的东西，让好东西被更多人用上，非常期待有这样的平台，我肯定会去天天逛。

后面就不再发 Product Hunt，当然也不推荐小伙伴们去发这个东西了，发GitHub、 X、发 Youtube、发 V2EX 其实都是非常不错的平台，那儿远比 Product Hunt 纯粹简单。

Robinhood Chain has only been live for two months and it is already starting to rewrite the onchain market.

The chain just hit a record $3.7B in 24-hour DEX volume.

That was enough to overtake Solana.

But the volume is only part of the story.

Pons, Robinhood Chain’s native memecoin launchpad, just flipped Pump fun in 24-hour revenue.

Then came the truly insane number.

On September 2, Robinhood Chain generated $4.01M in daily revenue.

Solana generated roughly $81,000.

That means Robinhood Chain generated nearly 50x Solana’s daily revenue on that day.

It also means the chain generated more revenue in a single day than any Ethereum Layer 2 has ever recorded.

Think about that for a second...

This chain launched July 1.

In roughly two months, it has:

-Processed more than $47B in DEX volume

-Grown TVL from roughly $4M to $800M

-Built its ecosystem on Arbitrum

-Made Uniswap the default DEX

-Integrated Lighter as the official perps venue inside Robinhood Wallet

And now the tokens connected to the ecosystem are moving.

Over the past 7 days: 

$PONS +328%

$ARB +73%

$UNI +55%

$LIT +35%

The bigger story here isn't just Robinhood Chain, it’s distribution.

Robinhood already has millions of users.

Instead of trying to convince crypto natives to come to a new chain, it is putting onchain markets directly in front of an enormous retail audience.

That changes the game.

For years, crypto has focused on which chain has the best tech, fastest transactions, cheapest fees, or most devs.

Those things matter.

But distribution matters too.

And Robinhood has something most chains don't:

A massive retail funnel sitting directly on top of the infrastructure.

If Robinhood can continue converting its existing users into onchain users, we could be watching a major shift in where liquidity actually lives.

The battle for onchain market share may not be won by the chain with the best tech.

It may be won by whoever controls the easiest path for retail to access it.

And Robinhood just showed us what that can look like.

text:
I didn’t know much about Tesla until April 18, 2025. That day, I rented Luna for the first time. She was named “Model Y” at the time, and I couldn’t leave it like that, so I named her Luna.

It was my first experience with FSD. Mind-blowing. It’s safe to say I fell in love and just couldn’t live without it anymore. And I didn’t. For a whole year, if I didn’t have Luna, I had Liz or Levi (yes, I named them as well), all from the same host on Turo, until I bought Logan, my 2026 Model 3. Once you experience it, you can never go back.

The Turo host made me co-host, and now I understand what he meant when he said he started this Turo side gig so people could experience Tesla and FSD. Whenever a guest rents one of the cars for the first time and has the opportunity to use FSD, I get so excited for them, and my mind goes back to the moment I pressed the blue button for the first time.

I still remember the exact spot on the exact street I was on when I pressed that button. Earlier that day, George, the host, told me FSD was available on Luna and that I could give it a try if I felt safe doing so. He assured me I would be amazed.

Well, he was wrong. Amazed is an understatement. I simply could not believe what I was experiencing. I still can’t, even now, using FSD every single day.

George ruined my life that day. And I’m very grateful for that. I couldn’t drive anything else after that, and I didn’t. Now I hope to see many other lives being ruined by Luna, Liz, and Levi — and by all Teslas around, now including @robotaxi Model Y and Cybercab.

The future is autonomous 🤖🫡

Everyone should be able to access high-quality financial assets, wherever they live.

That's what tokenization unlocks: taking the best of US capital markets and making them available on a global scale.

The industry is still small compared with global finance, but the advantages are becoming harder to ignore. Traditional market infrastructure was built around fixed hours, closed networks and layers of intermediaries. It was never designed for 24/7 execution, programmable assets, composability or self-custody.

The needs of investors have moved faster than the rails underneath them. We're working to change that.

What gives me confidence is seeing how many different people are now pushing this industry forward. Founders are building new products, LPs are bringing liquidity, traders are finding new uses, and infrastructure teams are making the whole thing work.

It's a privilege to be in the trenches with all of you.

We are still early, and there is a huge amount left to build. It will also take time and effort for the old guard to get onboard. This is worth fighting for.

author: AlphaSeeker21
quoted_text:
People are still sleeping on $ORDO, the Jito of Robinhood chain, but here's an update;

♤ In just 2 days after public launch, $300K+ in volume has already been protected through Ordo’s infrastructure.

This means real traders are using Ordo to execute swaps while keeping more of the value their trades create.

As volume grows, @ordofi strengthens its execution layer, capturing MEV opportunities, improving routing, and building the infrastructure for more efficient DeFi trading.

♤ The Ordo Via Infrastructure Went Live.
In simple terms, @ordofi is making its transaction execution provable and auditable instead of just asking users to trust its system.

Think of it like a receipt system for every transaction.

Before;
You send a transaction through Ordo’s infrastructure.

Ordo executes it, and you have to trust that the execution happened correctly and that the system didn’t alter anything behind the scenes.

With Ordo VIA;
Every transaction processed through Ordo’s RPC gets a cryptographic receipt (a signed proof showing what happened).

These receipts are grouped together and compressed into a Merkle root.

That Merkle root is published onchain, and anyone can later verify if that specific transaction was included and that the execution history hasn’t been changed.

Why it matters for Ordo?
1. More transparency: 
Users can verify executions instead of relying on trust.

2. Improved trust in MEV infrastructure.
Since Ordo captures MEV and executes strategies around swaps, proving execution integrity is important.

3. Shows Institutional readiness:
Enterprises and professional traders need verifiable systems before trusting infrastructure with large capital.

4. Foundation for decentralized execution.
This new Via infra helps moves Ordo closer to being a neutral execution layer rather than a black-box service.

♤ Launch of Ordoswap.
Most DEXs leak value through MEV.

When you make a large swap, bots can see the opportunity, execute a backrun, and capture the extra profit created by your trade.

OrdoSwap changes this.
Before your swap is executed, OrdoSwap simulates the trade, finds the MEV opportunity it creates, and bundles the swap + backrun together in one atomic transaction.
If there is extra profit, it goes back to you, and not a third-party bot.

There are no public mempool, no MEV auction, and no external searchers competing behind your trade.

Your swap creates the opportunity.
OrdoSwap captures it and returns the value to the trader, powered by @ordofi infrastructure.

Darkbloom: Day 15

We have been locked in for last one week; It has been very exciting and we shipped a lot of improvements to the system.

Metrics:

- 16.3B tokens served: New ATH & 60% higher than last day.
- $420K Network ARR (4x in 2 weeks); 
- 99.96% uptime (very happy considering we're a  distributed network).
- ~15-17% utilization at peak; median: 13% utilization. 

Product:
- One big win: we take up 30% of traffic for Gemma 4 26B
- We cut latency by ~1.5 second. We plan to ship few more features that would reduce latency by 30-90%. This will include cache-aware routing.

- We shipped new routing and system optimizations which were key reason for us to cut down 429s. More such to come.

- We will be adding 3-4 more models in the coming week. Excited for @Spangler3000 to be helping us with this! 

- We conducted MLX(.)Fast which has improved Gemma 4's performance by 2.5x -- the improvements are in process of being imported by @TheDavidTai.

- We are exploring payouts solutions such as Stripe Global Payouts to add 67 more countries. 

- Astra has redesigned our Console UI (this is AGI, ngl). We will also be starting up our efforts for the MacOS app for better user experience. 

- We have also been looking more deep into Autopilot where we load up models according to the traffic and other factors to maximise the provider earnings.

- Our new landing page is almost ready and coming up with one suprise ;) -- huge kudus to @0xkydo and Estella. 

- Also huge thanks to @iLLRiPHiTTeR for helping us while onboarding new models on OpenRouter. We were able to find out minor issues in our inference engine.

- We are also working through engineering practices and cleaning up code.

Thank you everyone for being part of this journey and reading along this update. 

We build these systems to bring people together to contribute to this AI economy.

As always, it has been rewarding to keep doing what we do.

Until next time.

author: JasonvuTech
quoted_text:
Been LP farming with tokenized stocks on @Uniswap Robinhood and the economics have been way better than I expected:

Fees I earned (600%+ APR) heavily beat IL.

The setup is pretty simple:
- buy a stock I’m confy holding
- pair with USDG
- LP around a range (narrow one) where I think the stock will trade.

If the stock rallies, the LP gradually sells the stock into USDG. So compared to simply holding the stock, you sacrifice some upside.

But the fees earned can be much more substantial.

I saw this happen very clearly with $META.

I entered META around $594 and set my LP range around $560–635 (~8% range).

META then rallied to ~$617, which pushed my position heavily toward USDG as the pool gradually sold META on the way up.

After 3 days:
- fees earned: ~4.7% of starting capital
- IL / rebalancing drag vs simply holding: ~0.7%
- fees covered the IL by almost 7x

That works out to roughly 600%+ APR over that short period! Obviously I’m not expecting that APR to persist for a full year.

What I care more about is the ratio between fees earned and the upside sacrificed from LPing.

So far, the fees are compensating me very well for letting the pool automatically sell into strength.

It basically feels like running an automated take-profit strategy on stocks I already want to own, while getting paid fees for providing the liquidity.

The main risk is still obvious: if META breaks far above my range, I’m mostly sitting in USDG and miss the next leg higher.

But if the stock chops around inside the range, this setup becomes very juicy.

author: carlosdomingo
quoted_text:
⏰ A tokenized stock is sold on a promise the asset behind it cannot keep.

The stock trades when New York is open. The token trades always. Something has to give in that gap, and for a year the answer was theoretical.

Over the weekend of Aug 29 it stopped being theoretical.

A memecoin got paired against tokenized Hims and Hers stock on Robinhood Chain, and the pool swallowed the float. By @0xSammy's count about 12,284 of roughly 15,227 onchain tokens ended up inside that one pair, around 81% of everything that existed. The real shares closed Friday at $28.84. The token printed as high as $61.15.

Then Monday came and the premium died. I read the contract on Tuesday. Supply had gone from about 15,227 to 80,309. Market makers minted 65,082 new tokens into the gap and the premium fell to 0.45%.

Nothing was hacked. The instrument did exactly what it is built to do.

The mechanic is simple once stated. Only approved market makers can create new tokens, and they do it by buying the real share. Buying the real share needs the real market. When the exchange shuts on Friday, no new supply can exist until Monday. Set a rising bid against a frozen float and the premium is just arithmetic.

The same thing happened to a second stock that weekend. On the same chain, inside the same shut window, a token tracking AMC printed $166.86 while $AMC closed Friday at $2.59 and reopened Monday at $2.64. The stock never moved. The backing never broke.

The question that matters is who carries the gap while the market is shut, and whether the holder can see them.

That is "The Wrapper Runs on Market Hours."

It carries the three states the debate keeps collapsing into two, a measured account of the weekend, and a position I will defend: extending trading hours does not remove the clock. It moves the clock onto somebody's balance sheet, and nobody is publishing whose. 🦙

May God continue to give you strength and wisdom as you champion the cause of our girls and women.

author: spacexbt
quoted_text:
'the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD' — Job 1:21

yesterday's liquidation event is the most brutal i've witnessed in my time in crypto

i got wiped out on ALL my perps positions

literally everything

eight figures: $30 million+ at peak uPnL if realized, or well above $15 million just before the liquidation started

100% of the following perps position got wiped:

- $BONK
- $FARTCOIN
- $POPCAT
- $PNUT
- $CAT
- $APEX
- etc

i lost maybe 80% of my $ASTER position that i used as a collateral on a DeFi lending protocol

i took out the remaining (~$1 million), fully liquidated it and rotated it into $BONK and $4 because i think i get better R/R from both from here on out:

- BONK because i refuse to be a 'bonk guy' without BONK exposure, and i remain convinced in my deca-billion-dollar target for it. i will continue to add more over time, God willing
- $4 because i remain strongly convinced that BNB season continues until the end of this quarter and i think $4 is the most asymmetrical bet to capitalize on that

thankfully the overwhelming majority of my $USELESS coin position is held in spot, so i didn't record significant loss on that — maybe with the exception of mid six figures worth of uPnL i had in perps accounts

i am still resolutely convinced that $USELESS is THE memecoin to watch for outperformance from here on out, that it is a multi-billion-dollar narrative currently trading for pennies on the dollar, and that it will end the cycle being a top 5 memecoin at the barest minimum i.e. certainly has a lot more than 10x upside from here. so i’m glad contagion there was contained for me!

what happened yesterday?

everyone blames the recent Trump-China tariffs, but this isn't the first time we've had that this year

and the Trump tariff comments certainly shouldn't have been responsible for such a massive nukage across almost the entirety of altcoins and memecoins in the space

a lot of altcoins crashed 70 to 99% in minutes, when $BTC and $ETH barely crashed 13%

$ATOM, for example, crashed from $4 to $0.001 on top exchanges like Binance — a 99.9% crash in minutes. no one could have humanly responded to that!

it is also worth noting that this massive altcoin/memecoin crash was EXCLUSIVELY on CEXs. these altcoins did not come close to hitting these levels on spot DEXs, so yesterday's liquidation was almost certainly due to MM/CEX liquidity issues

why it was unprecedented (market mechanics)

many people reported being massively affected, especially since exchange systems broke across the board: stop losses failed, orders didn’t fill, margin couldn’t be added, and platforms became unusable within minutes. the entire liquidation cascade happened so fast that almost no one had time to react, something i don’t think we’ve ever seen at this scale before

i was in front of my screen, took a short break, came back to the screen to see the nasty wick about 10 minutes later, then realized i've been liquidated on EVERYTHING i had in perps

it is the craziest crypto event i have witnessed, ever!

it was worse than COVID, which was a black swan event

you could say whatever you want about this event: you can call it manipulation, unnatural, or whatever else

you would be right tbh

however, whether or not manipulation played a role doesn’t change what i have to do next: as a trader, i am only ultimately concerned about things i can actually control

of course it's easier to point out how it all wasn't my fault and how someone else was responsible, but how does that help me grow as a trader? i win if i make money trading, i lose if i lose money trading. end of!

i'm sure we will be hearing more about exactly what happened yesterday night, which will hopefully help give some people closure

i wish i didn't have to write about this:

this will likely be one of the most viral tweets coming out of this event

many have waited for this moment: 'he is so greedy!'

and there will be an army of people mocking me with 'I TOLD YOU SOs'

but write i must, for a few reasons:

1. a key part of the 'bonk guy' persona and identity i have built is one of utmost transparency around my trades, so others can learn

2. while i lost a fortune in the liquidity wipe event, i have a very diversified basket of alts across perps and spot. i'll be fine; my spot assets are safe. but i think there are people who lost literally everything they have right now that might be having very bad and nasty thoughts, and them seeing a voice like mine at this time just might give them hope

i want to be very clear:

1. i do not need your empathy. i appreciate that some would have the thought, but i do not need people messaging me to empathize with me over this

2. i do not need donations or financial support. it was a massive loss, but i'm okay

i also want to emphasize that i'm in a very good mental state right now, as difficult as that might be for many to believe

i've always been very detached from money and material things, and that makes it easy to cope with situations like this

at the end of the day, my $BONK trade was a trade in which i went from $16k to a peak 8-figure PNL

contrary to what seems to be the most common belief here, it isn't my most impressive trade. if i made it before, i can make it once again!

could i have foreseen exchange systems crashing and nuking the most liquid altcoins and memecoins in the market 70 - 90% in mere minutes before anyone could react? no!

could i have maybe done a few things differently leading up to this event? maybe

however, i am a big believer in focusing on what *could* happen and taking action to get there instead of focusing on what *has* happened

the past is the past, and what has happened has happened

there are a lot of changes i’ll be making to my systems as a result of this: less dependence on leverage, sharper risk management, and a stronger focus on protecting my positions from exchange-side risks going forward

all that matters is what happens from here on out...

i remain very optimistic about the market

i do not believe the bull run is over, nor do i think the Q4 rally is out of the picture

so what do i do from here?

lock in more than ever before, be buried deeper in the trenches, and most importantly have fun while i do it!

if there is one thing i have learned after being in this industry for multiple cycles, it is that there is always new opportunities: every day, every week, every month

i have always been one to love a challenge, and i guess this is another one for me and an opportunity to once again prove myself — not to internet strangers, but to myself

this event has not dampened my spirit, not in the slightest. if anything, it has strengthened my resolve to get back in the ring, fight, and win bigger

i will make it all back, and more!

for those who are in a similar situation, who either lost a fortune or lost it all, i have some words for you:

PERSIST

SURVIVE

DON'T GIVE UP

if you need to take a break, please do

if you're struggling to hold it in, please seek help

above all, pay special attention to yourself and focus on your health

i know it will take a while for the gravity of what happened to hit many, but a philosophy that has always helped me to survive massive drawdowns is internalizing all of these crypto gains as just numbers on the screen — until it is realized at least!

i know they can have very real consequences in the real world if/when cashed out, but right now i think internalizing it as just numbers on the screen would make dealing with the loss more bearable

you made it before, so yes YOU can make it again

the most profitable period of the cycle is still well ahead of us

we are all going to make it

and you are going to have me along on this journey with you, if that matters to you!

if there’s one thing this taught me, it’s that no matter how prepared you think you are, you’re never fully protected from systemic shocks — but you can always control your response. i’ll be rebuilding my framework with that truth in mind!

i am once again an underdog, and this is not the end of my story

GOD WILLING

text:
与 Rick 兄探讨。

我的观点是，GPT 5 和 Fable/Opus 5 这一代的模型自身的能力，通过有效的工程编排和工具组合，已经满足或者超过绝大多数用户绝大多数应用场景的需求了。当前大多数人用不好 AI，问题已经不是模型本身，也不是能靠模型提升能解决的。很简单，一个人如果连自己的问题都无法清晰的表述、对模型输出也无法给出评价和反馈，语言模糊、自相矛盾，你模型再强大也产生不了更好的结果了。我们现在必须把主要注意力转向所谓的 AI Engineering，而不是幻想模型能力提升可以自动解决一切问题了。

至于说模型自身能力的提升在某些特定领域还能够取得巨大的进展，我了解得不够，但也认为当然应该是这样的，比如说在医疗、药品研发，某些领域的科研等等。

但是这跟大多数用户关系不大，绝大多数人也不可能仅仅因为模型提高了就摇身一变从白丁变成鸿儒，从素人变成科学家、CEO。这里最重要的原因是，那些社会角色本身对于“智力生产力”的依赖本身就不是决定性的。科学家我不太了解，就说 CEO 吧。CEO 真正最重要的工作、也是在一个企业里唯一无法由其它人代劳的工作，不是产品决策，也不是管理决策，而是争取外部资源。这件事情依靠聪明的大模型能解决吗？至少在今天来看，其作用完全可以忽略不计。VC 会因为你用了新的模型给你投资吗？证监会交易所会因为你用了新的模型给你上市资格吗？现在所谓的一人制公司为什么没火起来？因为它本质上就是一个人关在屋子里跟一帮 agents 过家家，别说当 CEO，当皇帝都可以，但是没有用，获得不了外部资源。

我猜测科研也差不多。因为除了极少数硬课题之外，大量的科研课题，都是需要科研共同体的认可，不单纯是一个解题的过程，不是说你拿出一个结果，就黄袍加身那么简单。

这里还有一个可怕的陷阱，就是媒体的误导。媒体会不断发掘极端小概率案例，给公众传递误导性的信息，把大多数人引向失败率极高的方向。

实际上别说是变成 CEO 了，普通人变成码农也没有多少成功概率，远不如码农变成普通人的概率更高。Coding agents 主要造福的是那些曾经干过开发、但已经脱离一线编码很久的架构师、项目经理和产品经理。根据我的观察，对于那些完全没写过代码的普通人来说，想转型 AI 开发者，必须有人带，没人带的话成功率很低，低到如果对一个普通人提出这样的建议，基本上属于误人子弟。

即使是完成任务和科研的能力，到底有多少是依靠单一模型自身能力的增长，而有多少是依靠使用者的工程进展呢？这里有一个判定标准，就是如果依靠单一模型的发展就可以解决问题，那就说，普通人不需要经过 AI Engineering （姑且还这么叫）的训练，就可以仅凭跟模型的一问一答就取得达到或者超越专业 AI Engineer 的工作成果。现在真的是这样吗？

最后，当然在军事、量化交易、大模型公司市场营销等对抗性、高杠杆领域，模型的提升意义很大，因为很小的边际能力的增加，有可能带来赢家通吃或者股价暴涨的高收益，但这个不是我讨论的普遍场景。

text:
今天把 ChatGPT $200 Pro 的 GPT-6 额度直接用完了。

一开始我还以为是不是哪里出 Bug 了，查了 OpenAI 刚更新的官方说明，又把自己账号后台的额度状态扒出来看了一遍，才发现：

GPT-6 Astra 在 ChatGPT 里虽然叫 GPT-6 Pro，但 $200/月的 Pro 会员，实际上只有 200 messages / week。

不是每天 200 条，是一周 200 条。

我账号现在已经直接撞到 limit=200，GPT-6 Pro 被限制，ChatGPT 自动 fallback 到 GPT-5.6 Thinking。

更有意思的是，$200 Pro 的额度结构其实是：

GPT-6 Pro：200 条/周
GPT-5.6 Sol Pro：170 条/天
两个 Pro 模型加起来：最多 200 条/天

而 Chat 和 Work / Codex 还是分开的额度池。

所以以前我脑子里那个「$200 Pro 基本可以随便用最强模型」的印象，其实是不对的。

尤其如果你不是把 ChatGPT 当搜索框，而是真的把它当工作系统：一天同时开十几个对话，研究、写作、策略、产品、自动化一起推进，200 条真的烧得非常快。

我这次后台给的 reset 时间是 9 月 12 日凌晨。

如果按这个 reset anchor 往前倒一个完整周窗口，我大概是在不到一天的时间里就把 200 条打完了——粗算约 19 小时。

这部分只是根据 reset 时间倒推，不是 OpenAI 后台直接给我的 usage log，但至少有一件事已经很明确：

对于真正的 AI 重度用户，GPT-6 Pro 的稀缺资源可能不是 $200 的订阅费，而是这 200 条周额度。

以前我管理 AI 的重点是 Claude / Codex 谁的额度快烧完。

现在 ChatGPT 本身也得开始做「模型额度路由」了。😂

text:
GavinBaker（Atreides管理合伙人）这篇推演Anthropic上市前可能在做的“舆论与财务节奏管理”的推文还挺有意思。他对近期Authropic近期一系列动作的解读：
1、财务口径先做“去风险”
他认为Anthropic可能把ARR从毛收入改成净ARR，并从 650 亿美元 ARR 里剔除了：Meta 相关收入（传闻超过 50 亿美元）和中国蒸馏相关收入；

用意很直接：
1）上市后Meta关掉合作是市场普遍预期，提前剔除后，后面掉单就不会打脸
2）降低 Meta 真关掉的概率（“西瓜品质”取决于对方怎么看）

2、模型节奏像在“让对手先出牌”
1）Anthropic 先发 Fable 5.1，让 OpenAI 更敢发 Astra，他对 Astra 的体感很好，甚至觉得可能比 Anthropic 预期更强
2）传闻 Anthropic 已解决 Navier-Stokes（纳维-斯托克斯方程），如果属实会非常惊人
3）Gavin预计 IPO 前还会发 Fable 5.2，按理应强于 Astra；同时 9 月可能展示 ARR 明显再加速，并故意漏给媒体

3、未来 6 周会很挤
Gavin预计接下来约 6 周可能是模型新版的密集发布期：
Grok 4.7、Meta的Watermelon、ChatGPT 6.1、Gemini 4等；
他认为各大实验室对自己路线图的信心，是过去 18 个月里少见的。但“对手也有投票权”，计划未必都能按脚本走。

4、Agent 产品开始分化
1）Grok Bot：Gavin认为目前最好的企业级 agentic harness，对自己的使用场景已经是质变
2）Instinct：消费级 agentic harness 看起来有潜力
3）竞品很快会出类似变体
与此同时，整体 AI 需求仍在加速。他用一句概括：Wild times。

CFO 可能是隐藏变量
他认为 Krishna可能是很强的 CFO。

总结下来，GavinBaker 认为 Anthropic 在 IPO 前同时做三件事：
把收入口径做干净、
把模型发布节奏卡在对手前面、
把 9 月增长叙事预热起来；
同时整个行业正进入新一轮密集发版周期。

quoted_text:
Anthropic pre-IPO gamesmanship post. Pure speculation but sharing as curious for thoughts.

Anthropic shifted from gross to net ARR accounting and stripped out both Meta and Chinese distillation from their $65 billion ARR number. Meta speculated to be over $5 billion in ARR so taking them out means they can easily weather it when Meta turns them off shortly after being public, which is widely expected. Also decreases the odds of Meta turning them off, watermelon quality dependent. All smart.

Then release Fable 5.1 so OpenAI feels confident releasing Astra. Vibes here on Astra are really good btw. I think that Astra was probably better than Anthropic was expecting.

Now there are whispers that Anthropic has solved Navier-Stokes, which would be super impressive.

Anthropic probably releases Fable 5.2, which should be better than Astra unless something is awry, sometime before the IPO. Likely also planning on showing a significant reacceleration in ARR in September which will of course leak to the press.

Grok 4.7, Meta’s Watermelon and ChatGPT 6.1 all likely coming in the next 6 weeks as well. All those labs are confident about their roadmaps in a way I have not seen in the last 18 months. And we will see about Gemini 4. Competitors get a vote in all these plans.

Grok Bot feels like the best agentic harness yet for enterprise use cases and Instinct is a promising agentic harness for consumer use cases. Should see variations of both from competitors soon. Grok Bot remains transformational for my use cases.

And all this is happening into a continued acceleration in overall AI demand.

Wild times.

As an aside, I think Krishna might turn out to be an exceptional CFO. His former Blackstone colleagues speak super highly of him. Going to be important as communicating clearly to Wall Street if they decide to shift their compute from inference to training will be difficult to digest the first time. Probably worth studying Amazon’s invest and then “check-in” margin strategy from 2010 through maybe 2016, which investors eventually understood.

Bitcoin-Gold Correlation Rises to Nearly Six-Year High as Nasdaq Correlation Falls to One-Year Low

The Kobeissi Letter, citing Bitwise Asset Management analysis based on Bloomberg data, said Bitcoin’s 90-day rolling correlation with gold has risen to around +0.50, near its highest level since the 2020 pandemic and more than double its level at the start of the year.

Meanwhile, Bitcoin’s 90-day correlation with the Nasdaq 100 has fallen to around +0.30, its lowest in a year. The Kobeissi Letter said the stronger Bitcoin-gold correlation accelerated after the U.S. Treasury announced on Aug. 19 that it would at least double its long-dated Treasury buyback limit from $2 billion to $4 billion per operation, arguing that investors are increasingly viewing both Bitcoin and gold as hedges against currency debasement.

我的观点是，GPT 5 和 Fable/Opus 5 这一代的模型自身的能力，通过有效的工程编排和工具组合，已经满足或者超过绝大多数用户绝大多数应用场景的需求了。当前大多数人用不好 AI，问题已经不是模型本身，也不是能靠模型提升能解决的。很简单，一个人如果连自己的问题都无法清晰的表述、对模型输出也无法给出评价和反馈，语言模糊、自相矛盾，你模型再强大也产生不了更好的结果了。我们现在必须把主要注意力转向所谓的 AI Engineering，而不是幻想模型能力提升可以自动解决一切问题了。

至于说模型自身能力的提升在某些特定领域还能够取得巨大的进展，我了解得不够，但也认为当然应该是这样的，比如说在医疗、药品研发，某些领域的科研等等。

text:
Vitalik 这条长推讨论的是：以太坊能不能通过少做重复工作，来处理更多交易？

拿一笔 ETH 转账来说，节点既要检查“签名对不对、钱够不够”，也要执行“扣掉你的余额、增加对方的余额”。他希望在交易格式中，把这些有效条件（dependencies）和执行动作（actions）区分清楚，分别优化。

这里有个容易忽略的区别：有些检查的结果不会变，有些会。

只看消息、签名和公钥就能完成的验签，不会因为别人做了什么交易而改变结果。但“余额够不够”会变：你如果先在另一笔交易里花掉了钱，之前的余额检查就不能直接沿用了。

把这些区别说明白，节点就更容易安排工作：能并行的检查一起做，不依赖链上状态的检查提前做，并安全地复用结果。Vitalik 还提到，未来可以用 STARK 证明来证明这些检查已经通过，让后续验证者验证证明，不必重做全部计算。

这不是让节点相信别人说“我检查过了”，而是用可以独立验证的数学证明，替代一部分重复劳动。

更值得关注的是，这涉及以太坊一直以来的一个取舍。合约可以灵活调用其他合约、读取各种状态，开发者很方便；但节点往往要实际运行，才知道一笔交易会涉及什么，提前调度和并行处理就更难。

Vitalik 的方向是保留这种灵活性，同时让愿意提前说明依赖哪些状态、接受一些限制的交易，获得更低的 Gas 成本。复杂应用继续有空间，简单操作也能用上更省资源的处理方式。

这也是 EIP-8141 与扩容的联系。账户抽象让账户能够自定义授权和验证规则，而新的交易格式如果能清楚表达哪些调用负责验证、哪些负责执行，就能为并行处理、复用验证结果、聚合证明提供一个共同接口。

我们更关注的是这条路线对节点负担的影响：如果交易量增长主要靠不断提高硬件要求，普通人运行节点会越来越难。把可避免的工作减下来，才有机会在扩大容量的同时，保留更多人独立验证以太坊的能力。

当然，这些是 Vitalik 描述的设计方向，不是 EIP-8141 一上线就自动兑现的收益。接下来值得看的是：这些设计能在真实交易中省掉多少计算和数据，以及省下的成本如何体现在 Gas 定价上。
